landingPageFaqs.question: Are online university degrees UGC-approved and recognized?
landingPageFaqs.answer: Yes, all online university degrees we recommend are UGC-approved and fully recognized by the University Grants Commission. These degrees have the same value as traditional campus programs and are accepted by employers, government organizations, and for higher studies.

landingPageFaqs.question: How does career counseling help in choosing online university degrees?
landingPageFaqs.answer: Our career counseling provides personalized guidance based on your career goals, academic background, and industry requirements. Our experts help you select UGC-approved programs that align with your professional aspirations, ensuring you make informed decisions about your education.

landingPageFaqs.question: What are the benefits of UGC-approved online university degrees?
landingPageFaqs.answer: UGC-approved online university degrees offer the same value as campus programs with added benefits of flexibility, cost-effectiveness, comprehensive career counseling support, and the ability to study while working. They are fully recognized and accepted globally.

landingPageFaqs.question: How do I apply for online university degrees through UNIFOST?
landingPageFaqs.answer: Applying is simple! Contact our career counselors who will guide you through the entire process - from university selection to application submission. We provide end-to-end support including document preparation, application assistance, and admission guidance.

landingPageFaqs.question: What courses are available in online university degrees?
landingPageFaqs.answer: We offer a wide range of UGC-approved online courses including MBA, BBA, MCA, BCA, B.Com, M.Com, BA, MA, and specialized programs. All courses are from top-ranked universities with flexible learning options and career counseling support.

landingPageFaqs.question: Is there any difference between online and regular degrees?
landingPageFaqs.answer: No, UGC-approved online degrees have the same value and recognition as regular degrees. The only difference is the mode of delivery—online degrees offer more flexibility and convenience while maintaining the same academic standards and curriculum.

landingPageFaqs.question: How much do online university degrees cost?
landingPageFaqs.answer: Online university degrees are generally more cost-effective than traditional programs. Costs vary by university and program, typically ranging from ₹1-4 lakhs for complete programs. Our career counselors can help you compare costs and find the best value options.

landingPageFaqs.question: What support do you provide during the online degree program?
landingPageFaqs.answer: We provide comprehensive support throughout your online degree journey including academic guidance, career counseling, placement assistance, networking opportunities, and 24/7 technical support. Our team ensures you have everything needed for success.
